instruction:
Open the provided init.ifc from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc using Revit's Open IFC workflow before editing, and use init_sheet.png as the local visual reference. Modify the starting model into a two-storey meeting center retrofit scheme with an overall 28.0 m by 14.0 m footprint near the project origin. The wall envelope should rise about 7.0 m, include three slab elements across the two-storey mass, and use curtain-wall glazing along the main facade. Save the deliverables on the Desktop using the exact filenames required below.

The IFC export must use the IFC4 schema, have unique GlobalId values for all IfcRoot objects, and contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, two IfcBuildingStorey entities, five IfcSpace entities, twelve IfcWall entities, three IfcSlab entities, and five IfcCurtainWall entities. Do not include IfcRoof, IfcDoor, IfcWindow, IfcStair, IfcColumn, IfcBeam, or IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. Name one space Central Lobby, and name the other spaces so the normalized IfcSpace names include at least four meeting spaces. The required BIM categories must be exported as real IFC building elements/spaces, not visual-only placeholders or proxy geometry. Coordinate placement, relationship entities, GUID values, Revit type names, materials, property sets, and harmless extra metadata may vary as long as the stated model geometry, element categories, space names, schedules, sheets, and file outputs are satisfied.
